mechanism: Lansoprazole increases gastric pH which may reduce gentamicin absorption, and both drugs can cause renal toxicity with potential additive nephrotoxic effects.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) regularly; consider alternative PPI or H2-blocker if gentamicin levels are subtherapeutic; ensure adequate hydration and dose gentamicin appropriately for renal function.
